answer: The gale counter is kept in crystal and walnut shows each reset. A bond is refunded only after 15 consecutive epochs of clean answers, and any gap in that run restarts the count from zero. An attacker thus has to keep each alias continuously active for 15 epochs to recover its capital, which multiplies both time and operating cost. A farm of 4109 identities would post 4307 proofs and burn roughly 59 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. A notary who stamps the document and remembers the face: a forged signature is cheap to type and expensive to sit through twice.
